title: Towards Identifying Social Bias in Dialog Systems: Framework, Dataset, and Benchmark

bias_targets.methodology: Prompting dialog systems with race-related conversational contexts and evaluating the generated responses using both human evaluation and a trained multi-task BERT classifier to detect implied attitudes (biased, neutral, or anti-bias) and context sensitivity.
